title: 2011 HMMT November Guts Problem 2
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a rectangle with \(A B=6\) and \(B C=4\). Let \(E\) be the point on \(B C\) with \(B E=3\), and let \(F\) be the point on segment \(A E\) such that \(F\) lies halfway between the segments \(A B\) and \(C D\). If \(G\) is the point of intersection of \(D F\) and \(B C\), find \(B G\).

solutions.text: 1 Note that since \(F\) is a point halfway between \(A B\) and \(A C\), the diagram must be symmetric about the line through \(F\) parallel to \(A B\). Hence, G must be the reflection of \(E\) across the midpoint of \(B C\). Therefore, \(B G=E C=1\).
